## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue
when one exists. Identify any compatibility or customer-integration impact.

## Verification

List actual commands and results. For behavior changes, include the meaningful
failing assertion before the fix and the passing result afterward. For UI changes,
include what you inspected in the visible browser. Mark blocked or unrun checks
explicitly; a source check is not customer acceptance.

## Review notes

- [ ] The patch is scoped and preserves unrelated work and owned-resource boundaries.
- [ ] Documentation and verification claims match the checks actually performed.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, raw private traces or build artifacts are included.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material and preserved applicable notices.

Mention any new dependencies, release/entrypoint changes, remaining limitation or
follow-up needed for review. Publishing and changing repository visibility are
separate maintainer actions.
